reason: Money is tight since daycare went up, and we do library storytime, parks and the zoo for free. $59 a month is a lot for something I can mostly replace with free stuff.
objection: I'm already paying more for daycare than I planned. Paying $59 a month, or even $12 a visit, for a play room when the library and parks cost nothing is hard to justify.
would_change_my_mind: A free or very cheap trial visit, or a drop-in price around $5 for a good rainy-day or hot-day option.
